svg.title: Operation bindings: input → action
svg.desc: Seven input classes on the left map to contextual bindings in the middle, which point at stable action ids in the registry on the right. Three rules underneath: conflicts block saving, bundles export and import, lower contexts can be isolated.

svg.text: Two bindings on one input in the same context block saving — not a warning.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: A bundle is JSON (format + format_version) for moving machines and sharing.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Contexts have priority, and lower ones can be isolated under higher ones.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Actions must be declared in a registry (id + label + category + context), never as private controller methods.
